title: Modal energy share and sideband instability: code and stored results
description: Code, stored results and verification scripts for D. Chelidze, 'Modal energy share and sideband instability: when is an identified damping value meaningful?' (submitted to Nonlinear Dynamics, 30 October 2026). Every number, table and figure in the paper is produced by this code from a simulated 24-mass chain with one grounded cubic spring; there are no measured data. Includes the stored results, a verifier that recomputes 161 quoted quantities and checks them against the manuscript, the pre-declared analyses with their SHA-256-recorded pre-declarations (88 further checks), and an unexecuted MATLAB port.
notes: Stored results in checkpoints/ and m_track/ are licensed CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA); code is MIT.
